title: Graph index eligibility is conservative and schema-directed: by default ...
content: Graph index eligibility is conservative and schema-directed: by default only vertex labels are word-indexed; graph schemas declare per-property annotations for text indexing and embedding participation, and embeddings are strictly per-kind opt-in under per-graph policy. No property is embedded or text-indexed implicitly.
rationale: Prevents accidentally indexing credential-shaped or personal-data property values, matches the settled meaning-bearing-vs-mechanical split (embeddings for claim/decision-like kinds, word index for mechanical kinds), and deciding the annotation surface now lets schema authors annotate as they write instead of migrating at unified-retrieval time (M9). Operator ratified 2026-08-13.
